name: VEEDHI
tagline: Turning road journeys into structured infrastructure intelligence.
summary: An AI-powered infrastructure intelligence platform connecting vehicle-based sensing, computer vision and geospatial processing to build a continuously updated view of road networks.
overview: VEEDHI transforms road inspection from fragmented footage and manual observations into a data pipeline. A journey becomes structured evidence: road-damage detections, geographic coordinates and map-based views that can support infrastructure monitoring and maintenance workflows.
features: Road journey video and GPS capture
Frame extraction and YOLO-based road-damage detection
Spatial data storage and map-oriented visualisation
A product roadmap toward road-network digital twins
architecture: The system separates field capture, inference, geospatial persistence and visualisation. Media objects are stored independently from structured detection metadata; PostGIS provides the spatial layer for location-aware querying and mapping.

name: GENOBOTIC / ROTO BOT
tagline: Microfluidics, microbiology and machine vision for antimicrobial resistance workflows.
summary: A point-of-care diagnostics initiative focused on rapid antimicrobial-resistance detection and antibiotic-susceptibility assessment.
overview: Genobotic combines microfluidics, microbiology, computer vision and AI/ML into a compact diagnostic workflow. The product work spans assay development, experimental design, image acquisition, dataset generation, model development and technology translation.
features: Dataset generation, model training and performance analysis
Integration of assay outputs with software interpretation
architecture: The engineering challenge is cross-domain integration: experimental assay design and biological readouts must connect to robust image acquisition, model inference and interpretable software outputs. Prototype development and clinical validation are distinct stages.

name: RECOLLIA / IMAGE ENGINE
tagline: A structured image engine for medical visual content.
summary: An AI-assisted workflow for creating and reviewing medical visual assets, with a concrete anatomical schematic prototype.
overview: The Recollia image-engine work focuses on producing medical visuals that are useful, consistent and reviewable. The current work includes a hernia / inguinal-canal anatomical schematic prototype and an evolving workflow for planning, generating and validating medical figures.
features: Medical figure planning from structured topics
Image review and visual quality checks
Human review as part of the asset lifecycle
architecture: The image engine is treated as a workflow rather than a single generation call. A figure moves through specification, generation, visual inspection and approval; the wider multi-stage orchestration continues to evolve.

name: REVOICE / PROJECT SPEECH
tagline: Electrolarynx speech in. Natural voice out.
summary: A web experience that turns electrolarynx speech into a natural voice note, ready to share through familiar messaging channels.
overview: ReVoice explores an accessible speech-restoration workflow. A user records audio in the browser or uploads a clip; the system denoises and transcribes the input, converts it using a personal voice index, and prepares the resulting voice note for sharing or download.
features: Browser microphone recording and audio upload
Voice conversion using RVC and a personal voice index
Restore and voice-enrolment modes in the application
stack: Frontend: HTML · CSS · JavaScript · MediaRecorder · Web Audio · Web Share API
Auth / jobs: JWT · bcrypt · background job queue
AI: PyTorch CPU · RVC · HuBERT · RMVPE · FAISS
Deployment: Docker Compose · Caddy · HTTPS · cloud VM
architecture: The application separates browser/mobile capture from backend processing. Audio jobs move through denoising, transcription and voice conversion before the output is passed to the device sharing workflow. Restore and voice enrolment currently take approximately 1–2 minutes per clip on CPU. Planned extensions include live Indic captions, a Telegram bot and Gmail sending.

name: ATHLETICOS
tagline: A digital assessment journey for discovering sporting potential.
summary: A sports-assessment application connecting student registration, physical parameters and movement assessment with sport-suitability insights.
overview: Athleticos presents a multi-step product journey for student assessment: profile creation, physical measurements, camera-based movement assessment, benchmark normalisation and sport-suitability reporting.
features: Ranked sport recommendations and training insights
stack: Underlying implementation stack can be expanded from the source project
architecture: The product is organised around a guided assessment workflow. It connects structured student data with movement observations and a report-oriented output.

name: VC FOUNDER MATCHING
tagline: Connecting founder discovery to relationship intelligence.
summary: An investment-intelligence workflow mapping founders' professional connections into the Indian VC ecosystem to surface relevant investor relationships and potential warm introductions.
overview: The pipeline explores how structured founder and startup research can be enriched with professional-network context. Rather than treating sourcing as a flat list, it maps relationships between founders, people and investor organisations to support discovery and outreach.
architecture: The system is modelled as a research and relationship pipeline: source information is extracted into entities, linked through professional connections and contextualised against the VC ecosystem. The current work is at architecture / prototype stage.

name: NAMMUDE GENOME
tagline: A software application in the genomics domain.
summary: A working genomics application developed to make a domain-specific scientific workflow accessible through software.
overview: Nammude Genome is part of a broader body of work translating biological and genomic subject matter into digital products. The portfolio presents it as a working application, with its detailed user journey and feature set represented by the live product interface.
features: Scientific information presented through a digital workflow
User-facing application rather than a static research document
stack: Application implementation details are available in the working product.
architecture: The application sits at the intersection of biological domain knowledge and software product design.

name: OTTA GARAGES
tagline: Book car service, repairs and on-road help from a local garage, with pickup and drop.
summary: A car-service marketplace where customers book service, repair and on-road help, and service centres and their drivers handle the job.
overview: Otta is a car-service marketplace. Car owners find a garage on the public website or in the Flutter app, see prices upfront and request a booking. The service centre sends an estimate, the customer approves it, and a driver can collect the car and bring it back, with every step visible. The repository holds the week-1 launch version: customer app, public website, partner dashboard and Firebase backend.
features: Customer app for Android and iPhone (Flutter) with phone-OTP login
Public website with garage listings by city, number-plate lookup, garage pages (photos, video tour, price list, reviews) and web booking
Partner dashboard for service-centre staff and drivers, including price editing
Estimate approval before any work starts; in week 1 customers pay at the centre by cash or UPI
Firebase backend: security rules, push notifications, account deletion, and reviews created when a delivered order is rated
stack: Firebase: Auth, Firestore (Mumbai), Cloud Functions, Hosting
Licensed RC-verification API for plate lookup
architecture: The customer app, public website and partner dashboard share one Firebase project. Website bookings are written to the same orders collection as the app, tagged as coming from the website. Cloud Functions handle push notifications, account deletion, vehicle lookup and review creation. Self drop-off skips the driver steps. Until the Firebase config is added, the website runs in a demo mode on sample garages.
metrics: Cash or UPI at the centre
Razorpay, driver and merchant apps, live driver map, admin panel

name: AGAR / MICROBIAL COLONY DETECTION
tagline: Detecting five bacterial species on petri dishes with YOLOv8.
summary: A computer-vision workflow that detects and classifies bacterial colonies in petri dish images, presented as a research poster on pathogen detection for antimicrobial resistance.
overview: AGAR is a computer-vision project for microbial plate imagery. A YOLOv8n detector was trained on 6,500 petri dish images from the public AGAR dataset to detect and classify five species: E. coli, C. albicans, P. aeruginosa, B. subtilis and S. aureus. The work is presented as the poster "CNN based detection of pathogens to tackle antimicrobial resistance".
features: 6,500 petri dish images selected from the public AGAR dataset
Detection and classification of five species
YOLOv8n trained for 20 epochs with Ultralytics
Evaluation with precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95, confusion matrices and precision-recall curves
Next step: training on a dataset specific to resistant pathogens
architecture: The workflow connects labelled plate images to model training and inference. The poster notes that the lower mAP50-95 leaves room to improve, and names resistant-pathogen data and validation in real hospital settings as the next steps.

poster.title: CNN based detection of pathogens to tackle antimicrobial resistance
poster.authors: Pranoy M S, Vinay Bhaskar, Abhishekh Jangid, Anurag Chandrakar, Sriram Bharath
points: Model: YOLOv8n trained for 20 epochs on 6,500 AGAR plate images
Species: E. coli, C. albicans, P. aeruginosa, B. subtilis, S. aureus
Next: train on resistant-pathogen data and validate in hospital settings

name: RORSCHACH GENERATOR
tagline: Procedural generation of symmetrical inkblot forms.
summary: A generative graphics experiment exploring controlled symmetry, procedural shapes and visual variation.
overview: The Rorschach Generator explores how symmetrical inkblot-like forms can be constructed digitally. Its focus is procedural image generation and visual control rather than clinical interpretation.
architecture: The generator is an experimental visual-computing prototype. It is not a clinically validated psychological instrument.

name: HYDROLOOP
tagline: A hierarchical bio-based hydrogel cartridge for textile wastewater treatment.
summary: A research-led product concept combining bio-based hydrogel materials and modular treatment stages for textile wastewater.
overview: HYDROLOOP explores a cartridge-based approach to textile wastewater treatment using a hierarchical bio-based hydrogel architecture. The concept connects adsorption, material reinforcement and enzyme immobilisation in a modular treatment design.
architecture: The concept is structured as a modular treatment cartridge in which material layers provide complementary functions. This is a research and product-design concept rather than a deployed software product.
